versions.changelog:
Version 0.1.1 of ppt-to-web-generator

- No file changes were detected in this release.
- Documentation, usage, and workflow rules remain unchanged.

Initial release of tutorial-website-builder

- Provides two workflows: extract reusable UI style prompts from reference images, or generate paged HTML tutorials from procedural content and media.
- Enforces three key logic rules: no card-inside-card construction, only purposeful graphics, and tutorial readability priority.
- Supports style selection (with configuration option) using prompts saved in the references folder.
- Generates single-file, paged tutorials with navigable steps, responsive layout, embedded media, and clickable image enlargements.
- Ensures accessibility and quality gate checks, including correct figure numbering, navigation logic, and local file compatibility.
